name: HMMT-25
intro: HMMT-25 是 MathArena 收录的 2025 年 2 月 Harvard-MIT Mathematics Tournament 决赛题集，包含 30 道经提取、格式统一和人工核验的竞赛数学题。MathArena 以四次独立作答的 pass@1 准确率评估模型，并结合符号等价解析、语义判题和人工复核降低评分误差。
build_method: 官方赛题提取、格式标准化、人工核验
metric: Pass@1 Accuracy（4 次独立运行均值）, Score/Rank Confidence Intervals
eval_feature: 新近竞赛、发布日期标记、四次独立运行、解析器与语义判题复核
build_method_en: Official problem extraction, format standardization, human verification
eval_feature_en: Fresh competition, release-date flags, four independent runs, parser and semantic-judge review
intro_en: HMMT-25 is the February 2025 Harvard-MIT Mathematics Tournament finals set included in MathArena. It contains 30 competition problems extracted from official materials, standardized, and manually verified. MathArena evaluates four independent responses with pass@1 accuracy and combines symbolic-equivalence parsing, semantic judging, and manual review to reduce scoring errors.
metric_en: Pass@1 Accuracy (mean of 4 independent runs), Score/Rank Confidence Intervals
drawio_review_note: Aligned with MathArena (arXiv:2505.23281), its official HMMT February 2025 configuration, and the MathArena/HMMT dataset card. The 30 official finals problems and answers are extracted, standardized, and manually checked for typos, inconsistencies, and formatting. Models receive the competition prompt with a boxed-answer instruction and produce four independent responses per problem using provider-recommended settings. A custom LaTeX-to-SymPy parser checks symbolic equivalence; Gemini 2.5 Flash handles semantic-equivalence cases. The authors manually review flagged short outputs, parser failures, answers present in reasoning traces, and parser/judge disagreements. Reporting uses pass@1 accuracy averaged over four runs plus score/rank confidence intervals, while release-date flags expose potential post-release contamination.
